name: Dodemoi
source:
Butt naked muscle man.
[spoiler]He survives Chris Kanu's strong head-blow and was left with a flattened head, but later Mezaroa's strike kills him.[/spoiler]
His name originates from "Doudemoii" which means "whatever".
He was a former assassination target with a priority number of 130.
